title: Earth-ionosphere Schumann resonance around 7.83 Hz
claims: An ideal thin spherical Earth-ionosphere cavity has eigenfrequencies f_n=(c/(2 pi R))*sqrt(n(n+1)).
Real Earth-ionosphere resonances are shifted from the ideal cavity values by finite conductivity and propagation effects.
The first observed Schumann resonance is around 7.8-7.83 Hz.
boundary: 7.83 Hz is an Earth-ionosphere electromagnetic resonance frequency; this source does not identify it as an M-theory frequency.
